semantic.justification: Original base assignment copies actual field/stamp/time/cache/locale/week state and clones the owned source zone in source order. The ephemeral CalendarZoneReference tag represents only the native const-reference constructor overload; it is never stored as fZone and does not create a second Calendar state object. This tag keeps cloning inside base initialization, after incoming-status check and clear and before week data, unlike an early clone adapter that would lose a nonnull clone when its virtual callback changes the aliased status. Physical pointer/const-reference syntax is the host-language projection. Unchanged ICU78.3 library witnesses pass 14994 locale/week cases over 993 requested names and 1440 constructor/copy/weekend cases. They observe all six week/weekend fields, valid/actual Locale values and literal root IDs, incoming error/warning behavior, default and keyword timezone selection, reference/adoption clone counts, null/error and aliased-status clone callbacks, all initialized field/stamp/flag and derived state, date-versus-clock initialization, completed UTC fields and weekend work clones. Existing 63050 scalar/calendar and 12929 time cases also pass after fixtures use real constructors and explicit public controlled baselines.
